label: Lasting ground (A2ab) from CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining causes and contact
meaning: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A2ab (lasting ground) of Arrival A. Let a concrete x be absent at s and present at t > s in history v. It has a concrete sustaining cause g (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2), which gives x being at every moment x is present, in particular at t; by the contact principle g is present at t, which is after s; and g is a ground of x. No condition on the order of time (any preorder), on first moments or on convexity is used. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation: without the sustaining-cause premise (Control part 3), without sustainers-are-grounds (part 5), without the contact principle (part 2); all hold nonvacuously with A2ab (part 7). Existential inertia rejects the sustaining-cause premise; it need not reject A2ab, which also has the originating route. All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
